subject: Sarith
fact: Sarith was trained by Lolth's guards and considers himself an expert.
source_quote: The Lolth’s guards trained me. I am an expert

subject: Sarith recommends Daz for interrogation
fact: Sarith recommends that Daz be given the first crack at extracting information.
source_quote: I recommend that he be given the first crack at extracting information.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum suspects religious conflict between Duergar and Dwarven gods is not the real cause of hostility.
source_quote: he thinks there might be some rivalry between the Duergar gods and the Dwarven gods

subject: Grygum concludes conflict is political
fact: Grygum concludes that the conflict is the will of the people, not the gods.
source_quote: This is not the will of any god. This is the will of the people

subject: Gracklstugh
fact: Gracklstugh is the Duergar metropolis in this part of the Underdark.
source_quote: the metropolis of the Duergar in this part of the Underdark

subject: Darklake district
fact: Non-Duergars are only permitted to move freely in the Darklake district of Gracklstugh.
source_quote: Non-Duergars are only permitted to move freely in the Darklake district

subject: Duergar
fact: Duergar can become invisible at will.
source_quote: The Duergar can become invisible at will

subject: Gracklstugh
fact: Gracklstugh is a city of slavers.
source_quote: it’s a city of slavers

subject: Gracklstugh
fact: The buildings in Gracklstugh are plain and functional, lacking art and opulence.
source_quote: the buildings are plain and functional... the walls of the Duergar homes are plain

subject: Gracklstugh
fact: Gracklstugh has the ambiance of a work camp, filled with the sounds of hammering, heat, and smelter light.
source_quote: the sound of hammers warping metals, the stench and heat, and the light of the smelters make all of Gracklstugh appear as one large work camp

subject: Gracklstugh
fact: The acrid smoke in Gracklstugh burns through Daz’s sense of smell.
source_quote: the acrid smoke makes breathing hard and burns through his sense of smell

subject: Grygum asks purpose of visit
fact: Grygum asks what they are doing in Gracklstugh.
source_quote: So what are we doing here?

subject: Jimjar suggests buying equipment
fact: Jimjar whispers that they should buy equipment to survive more easily and get information on leaving the Underdark.
source_quote: Buy equipment so we can survive more easily. Get information on how to get out of the Underdark.

subject: Sethir mentions Lost Tomb of Khem
fact: Sethir mutters that they plan to go to the Lost Tomb of Khem to find treasure.
source_quote: We plan to get equipment and then go to the Lost Tomb of Khem, where we will find treasure!

subject: Blade Bazaar
fact: The Blade Bazaar is named after the most abundant goods the Duergar offer.
source_quote: This marketplace is named after the most abundant goods the duergar offer

subject: Blade Bazaar
fact: The Blade Bazaar sells almost everything available in Gracklstugh, including goods from visiting merchants.
source_quote: the shops here sell almost everything available in the city, along with stalls set up by visiting merchants

subject: Blade Bazaar
fact: The Blade Bazaar has a din of people arguing mainly in Dwarvish that nearly drowns out the forges.
source_quote: The din of people arguing, mainly in Dwarvish, nearly drowns out the hammering coming from the city’s forges

subject: Blade Bazaar
fact: The crowds at the Blade Bazaar offer a good chance to slip away from pursuers.
source_quote: the crowds here offer a good chance to slip away from pursuers

subject: Daz decides to go to Blade Bazaar
fact: Daz says out loud, 'To the Blade Bazaar.'
source_quote: To the Blade Bazaar,' he says out loud.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin remembers castaways before reaching the docks.
source_quote: Thorin remembers some castaways.

subject: Brannum Redmarch
fact: Brannum Redmarch pleads not to be turned in to the Duergar guards.
source_quote: You wouldn’t turn me into the guard?

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is disappointed that magical goods cannot be purchased in the Darklake District.
source_quote: Zalthir has been thinking about some magical items he wants and was disappointed when Hemeth said that magical goods could be purchased in Gracklstugh but not in the Darklake District.

subject: Zalthir asks about Eldritch Claw Tattoo
fact: Zalthir asks if either Hemeth or Brannam can get him an Eldritch Claw Tattoo.
source_quote: Can either of you get me Eldritch Claw Tattoo?

subject: Hemeth
fact: Hemeth says he cannot get the Eldritch Claw Tattoo.
source_quote: No.

subject: Brannum Redmarch
fact: Brannum Redmarch says he can get the Eldritch Claw Tattoo but it will take a few days.
source_quote: Yes! I know a guy. But it will take a few days.

subject: Brannum demands slate wiped clean
fact: Brannum Redmarch says the slate is wiped clean after getting the item.
source_quote: And then the slate is wiped clean?

subject: Thorin threatens Brannum
fact: Thorin tells Brannum there will be consequences if he betrays them.
source_quote: if we don’t get what we want, and you betray us, there will be consequences.

subject: Brannum Redmarch
fact: Brannum Redmarch shrinks in response to Thorin’s threat.
source_quote: Brannam shrinks

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido pleads to be let go, claiming his actions were part of the divine plan.
source_quote: Look, I made mistakes. It was the divine plan. Just let me go. I won’t bother you again.

subject: Spiderbait
fact: Spiderbait wants to kill Buppido on the spot.
source_quote: Spiderbait, still seething with rage, wants to kill him on the spot

subject: Thorin considers killing Buppido
fact: Thorin is tempted to kill Buppido but waits to hear others’ opinions.
source_quote: Thorin is tempted, he wants to see what everyone else has to say.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir thinks Buppido may betray them.
source_quote: Perhaps he will betray us.

subject: Thorin draws sword on Buppido
fact: Thorin pulls his sword and asks, 'So we kill him?'
source_quote: So we kill him?

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum intervenes and says they shouldn’t worry about Buppido because there are worse threats.
source_quote: There are so many people who will kill us that I am not so sure we should worry about him.

subject: Daz proposes releasing Buppido
fact: Daz votes to get as close to a guarantee as possible and then let Buppido loose in the city as they leave.
source_quote: I vote that we get as close to a guarantee as we can and then, as we leave, let him loose in the city.

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido pleads again, saying he was mad and learned from Shuushar.
source_quote: I made mistakes. I was mad. The divine plan called me, and I realized it was a mistake. I have learned from Shuushar that I was mad. PLEASE!

subject: Zalthir gives Buppido Tongue of Madness
fact: Zalthir hands Buppido the Tongue of Madness and tells him to eat it.
source_quote: Zalthir hands him a mushroom, The Tongue of Madness, and says, 'Eat.'

subject: Buppido eats Tongue of Madness
fact: Buppido eats the Tongue of Madness and starts talking.
source_quote: And Buppido does and starts talking.

subject: Buppido reveals desire to return to bolt hole
fact: Buppido says he just wanted to return to his bolt hole in the caverns near the city to praise the Divine Plan.
source_quote: I just wanted to return to my bolt hole in the caverns near the city and praise the Divine Plan.

subject: Buppido insults companions
fact: Buppido says Daz has foul-smelling breath, Thorin thinks his muscles are impressive, and Eldeth is not interested in Thorin.
source_quote: You all have been so annoying. Daz has foul-smelling breath. Thorin thinks his muscles are impressive. Eldeth is -not- interested in him.

subject: Grygum reveals Zalthir’s unclean scales
fact: Grygum says Zalthir’s scales haven’t been cleaned in ages.
source_quote: Zalthir’s scales haven’t been cleaned in ages.

subject: Grygum complains about Jimjar’s breathing
fact: Grygum tells Jimjar to stop his annoying breathing.
source_quote: Jimjar’s bEttin g is so annoying! GIVE IT A REST.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir says he likes Grygum.
source_quote: I like him.

subject: Thorin assigns Jimjar surveillance
fact: Thorin tells everyone to keep an eye on Jimjar.
source_quote: You all need to keep an eye on him.

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar smiles and asks if Thorin wants to bet.
source_quote: Wanna bet?

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir wonders if Buppido can summon Demogorgon like the Kuo-toa.
source_quote: So - wait, I mean, can he summon Demogorgon like the Kuo-toans?

subject: Jimjar laughs at Zalthir’s question
fact: Jimjar roars with laughter at Zalthir’s question.
source_quote: Jimjar roars with laughter.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir thinks Jimjar is judging him.
source_quote: Zalthir can’t help but think Jimjar is judging him.
